assumptions: Hits are candidate hits: the logged answer is not checked against the new request (ADR-0006); correctness unmeasured until the K-1 review (X1).
Saving is the recorded cost of avoided calls, before lookup overhead and before the build cost (regeneration or judging) that ADR-0016 charges.
Measured potential, not a serving decision: global scope within a bot; every bot has one owner account, so cross-user reuse is unmeasured (ADR-0016).
Ineligible: no user text, non-STOP or empty answer, attachments, tools, actions, bad times, workflow rows, memory on or unknown, RAG run or unknown.
No time-sensitivity detector exists (TODO-07): time-dependent questions can be admitted.
Instructions are a bot snapshot (bot_ins_h_exact): changes over time are not seen, so the instruction key part does not split a bot's traffic.
Days are naive calendar days of the user timestamp (Q-06).
Headline variant: only requests with no logged history (n_prior_msgs == 1, the request's own question) are admitted or hit.
Fees are a proxy: 0.002 per per-call billing item (ADR-0032); it understates the recorded fee block by about 5% and overstates token cost by the same.
Report period (Aug-Oct 2026) read once; the window may look back into the tune period (owner decision 2026-11-02). Period is from a_timestamp, days from u_timestamp (naive, Q-06).
Guard: no approval step, empty blocklist, no disabled bot, key version pq-v1; every served key would still need approval before serving.
Tenant slices: the 10 largest tenants by LLM requests (opaque ranks); traffic_weighted slice not computed.
The working tree had uncommitted changes when this ran.
Repriced baseline in price-file units, token cost only (fees are not on the price list); no interval computed.
